index.title: Electronic Catalog Maker — Interactive Image Catalogs
index.hero.title: Turn any image into an interactive catalog.
index.hero.text: Add clickable hotspots to photos and diagrams. Attach product details, part numbers, and links — all in one catalog file.
index.demo.title: See how it works
index.demo.intro: Select a marker or use the arrows to explore item details. Use Fit to see the whole image.
index.demo.note: Buy opens our demo store checkout, where every item costs $0.
index.demo.steps: Build your own: add an image → mark the details with hotspots → save the catalog file and open it in Viewer.
index.demo.noscript: The live demo needs JavaScript — use “Open full demo” above.
index.who.title: Who it's for
index.who.parts.title: Parts and equipment
index.who.parts.text: Connect items in a diagram with part numbers and descriptions.
index.who.furniture.title: Furniture and products
index.who.furniture.text: Add details to objects or components in a photograph.
index.who.teaching.title: Teaching and learning
index.who.teaching.text: Explorable diagrams for lessons and class projects — no student accounts, no cloud. See the schools page →
index.apps.title: The apps
index.apps.editor.title: Editor →
index.apps.editor.text: Build a catalog: place hotspots on an image, attach data to each.
index.apps.viewer.title: Viewer →
index.apps.viewer.text: Open a catalog file and click around it.
index.apps.collab.title: Collaboration Server
index.apps.collab.text: Optional, self-hosted: edit a catalog live with someone else.
index.benefits.title: Built around your catalog files
index.benefits.free.title: Free, no subscription
index.benefits.free.text: The apps are free and open source (MIT). No accounts, no plans.
index.benefits.file.title: Your catalog is one file
index.benefits.file.text: Images, hotspots and data live together in a single .ecatm file on your device. It goes nowhere unless you share it.
index.benefits.photos.title: Photos and diagrams
index.benefits.photos.text: Put hotspots on any image — a furniture photograph, a parts diagram, an anatomy chart.
index.benefits.store.title: Links to your own store
index.benefits.store.text: Point items at any online store you already use. There's no marketplace or checkout of ours in between.
index.benefits.offline.title: Works offline after you first open it
index.benefits.offline.text: After you first open the apps on a computer, tablet or phone, they are cached in your browser and keep working without a connection.
index.benefits.live.title: Live editing, only if you want it
index.benefits.live.text: Editing together needs the optional, self-hosted Collaboration Server. Everything else works without it.
index.dialog.title: Collaboration Server downloads
index.dialog.intro: Run the Collaboration Server yourself to edit a catalog live with other people. You don't need it to create or view a catalog on your own.
index.dialog.windows: Windows: Get it on Microsoft Store (or direct download, .exe file)
index.dialog.linux: Linux: Get it on Snap Store (Ubuntu App Center, or direct download for other distros)
index.dialog.macos: macOS: (requires macOS 13+) direct download (Apple Silicon, or Intel) — unzip, then see the release page for the one-line Terminal command needed on first run
index.dialog.chromebook: Chromebook (Linux/Crostini): direct download, .deb file — see the release page for setup
common.footer.note: — catalogs stay on your disk unless opened from a URL.
index.footer.embed: See it embedded on a website →

schools.title: Electronic Catalog Maker for Schools
schools.tagline: Got a diagram? In a few minutes it's a click-around class project — no accounts to create, no cloud to trust, nothing to pay for.
schools.points.privacy.title: No accounts, no student data
schools.points.privacy.text: A catalog is just a file on your own device. There's no cloud database behind it — nothing to sign up for, and nothing to breach or leak.
schools.points.group.title: Real-time group projects
schools.points.group.text: A whole class can label one diagram together, live, on the same file at once — using the free, optional collaboration server.
schools.points.year.title: Still works next year
schools.points.year.text: A file saved in September opens exactly the same in June — no renewal, no expiring account, no breaking update to worry about.
schools.points.free.title: Free apps, no subscription
schools.points.free.text: The same Editor and Viewer everyone else uses — just switched to "Education" mode, which relabels Buy/Cart into Learn more/Collection.
schools.demo.title: 🧫 Try it — an animal cell, ready to click around
schools.demo.hint: This demo catalog has "Education" mode switched on: notice the toolbar says "📚 Collection" instead of "🛒 Cart", and each part says "Learn more" instead of "Buy" — same app, same file format, just relabeled for a classroom.
schools.build.title: ✏️ Build your own
schools.build.text: Drop in a diagram — a cell, an engine, a map, a machine — place a few hotspots, and it's a class project. Works offline after you first open it on a computer, tablet or phone, and keeps working after the bell rings on the last day of school.
